name: Keep Right
purpose: Power blocking, but the quarterback fakes the toss and keeps it around the edge. When their outside defender starts crashing hard on the wing, this is the play that makes him pay.

LE.rule: Block back and cut off pursuit.

LT.rule: Block back. Take the first defender on or inside you.

LG.rule: PULL RIGHT and wrap up through the hole. Block the first wrong-colored jersey inside the kick-out.

C.rule: Block back on the backside gap.

RG.rule: Block the man over you. If nobody is over you, help the center and climb to the linebacker.

RT.rule: Block down on the first defender inside you.

RE.rule: Block down on the first defender inside you.

LW.rule: Sprint flat behind the line and sell the sweep to the backside.

RW.rule: Take one hard step like you are catching the toss, then turn and block the widest defender on your side.

QB.rule: Reverse pivot and fake the toss with both hands, then hide the ball on your hip and run wide around the end. Get to the corner before you turn up.

FB.rule: Kick out the first defender outside our end, same as power. Nothing changes for you.

coaching_points: Everything except the quarterback and the playside wing is identical to power. That is the point — they should not be able to tell until it is too late.
The fake has to be a real toss motion with both hands. A lazy fake and the outside defender never leaves.
Save this one. Call it the series after their end has blown up two powers in a row.
The quarterback gets down or out of bounds. We are not trading our quarterback for four yards.
